msgid: %(n)s student already holds a seat on this slot. If you change the stipend, location, qualification, start date or duration, they will be notified.
msgid_plural: %(n)s students already hold a seat on this slot. If you change the stipend, location, qualification, start date or duration, they will be notified.
msgstr: Mwanafunzi %(n)s tayari ana nafasi kwenye nafasi hii. Ukibadilisha posho, eneo, sifa, tarehe ya kuanza au muda, ataarifiwa.
Wanafunzi %(n)s tayari wana nafasi kwenye nafasi hii. Ukibadilisha posho, eneo, sifa, tarehe ya kuanza au muda, wataarifiwa.

msgid: %(n)s student has a seat on this slot and will be told about these changes:
msgid_plural: %(n)s students have a seat on this slot and will be told about these changes:
msgstr: Mwanafunzi %(n)s ana nafasi kwenye nafasi hii na ataambiwa kuhusu mabadiliko haya:
Wanafunzi %(n)s wana nafasi kwenye nafasi hii na wataambiwa kuhusu mabadiliko haya:

msgid: %(n)d paid applicant is waiting for your acceptance: %(slot)s
msgid_plural: %(n)d paid applicants are waiting for your acceptance: %(slot)s

msgstr: %(slot)s inafungwa %(when)s ikiwa na kiti %(n)d bado kiko wazi
%(slot)s inafungwa %(when)s ikiwa na viti %(n)d bado viko wazi

msgid: %(booked)s seat is already booked or paid for, so the capacity cannot be lower than %(booked)s.
msgid_plural: %(booked)s seats are already booked or paid for, so the capacity cannot be lower than %(booked)s.
msgstr: Kiti %(booked)s tayari kimehifadhiwa au kimelipiwa, kwa hiyo uwezo hauwezi kuwa chini ya %(booked)s.
Viti %(booked)s tayari vimehifadhiwa au vimelipiwa, kwa hiyo uwezo hauwezi kuwa chini ya %(booked)s.

msgid: Slot updated. %(n)s student was notified of the change.
msgid_plural: Slot updated. %(n)s students were notified of the change.
msgstr: Nafasi imesasishwa. Mwanafunzi %(n)s amearifiwa kuhusu mabadiliko.
Nafasi imesasishwa. Wanafunzi %(n)s wamearifiwa kuhusu mabadiliko.
